name: io.github.iowarp/slicer-mcp
title: CLIO Slicer
description: Slice 3D models (STL, 3MF, STEP) with the PrusaSlicer or OrcaSlicer installed here, and see the...

tools.name: list_printers
tools.description: List the printer presets the installed slicer knows. With no argument: its vendors. With vendor: that vendor's printer models and presets. With printer (words such as 'Prusa MK4' or an exact preset name): the matching preset and its quality (layer height) and material presets.

tools.name: slice
tools.description: Slice a 3D model (STL, 3MF, STEP, OBJ) for a printer with the slicer installed here. printer, material and quality are words ('Prusa MK4', 'PLA', '0.2 mm') or exact preset names; the presets chosen are reported. overrides sets slicer settings by their own names (support_material: true, fill_density: '20%', brim_width: 5); rotate turns the model in degrees about x, y, z before slicing. Returns a slice id, print time, filament in grams and metres, layer count, and the slicer's warnings in words. The G-code stays with the server; export writes it out.

tools.name: layer_stats
tools.description: Time and filament of a slice by feature type (outer wall, inner wall, infill, support, travel …) over a range of layers (all when omitted), the slowest layer, and one row per layer (layer, z_mm, time_s, filament_g, the types it prints and where on the bed each prints).

tools.name: export
tools.description: Write a slice out: format 'gcode' (the plain-text G-code for the printer) or 'csv' (one row per layer: z_mm, height_mm, time_s, filament_g and time per feature type, for a chart). path defaults to the model's folder.

tools.name: compare_slices
tools.description: Compare two or more slices: print time, filament, layers, presets, overrides and where the time goes, each against the first.

tools.name: show_slice
tools.description: Open a slice in an interactive view the person can turn and zoom: the toolpaths layer by layer, coloured by feature type (walls, infill, support, travel), with a layer slider, a toggle per type, the print time, filament (grams and metres), layer count and height, and the slicer's warnings. The view reports the shown layer as layer and z_mm and the person's pick as selection; its tools go_to_layer, set_feature_visibility and pick_segment move it: to show another layer in a view that is already open, call go_to_layer rather than opening another view. Pass layer to open on a layer.

tools.name: slice_layers
tools.description: Toolpaths of a range of layers for the slice view to draw. Called by the view itself.

tools.name: remember_slice_view
tools.description: Save the layer and the feature types the slice view shows, so reopening it shows them again. Called by the view itself.

resources.name: slicer_layers
resources.description: An interactive view of a sliced print, layer by layer (three.js).

resources.name: capabilities
resources.description: Describe what the slicer MCP server can do.
